About School Notice Board System

The School Notice Board Management System is an enterprise-grade digital communication platform designed to streamline announcement dissemination, improve school-to-student engagement, and automate multi-channel notifications.

Core Capabilities

  • Role-Based Access Control: Distinct access hierarchies for Administrators, Faculty/Teachers, Students, and Parents.
  • Audience Targeting: Broadcast publicly or target specific departments and student cohorts.
  • JPQL High-Performance Queries: Optimized indexing and multi-criteria active notice filtering.
  • Real-time Analytics Dashboard: Live insights into department notice productivity and category engagement.
  • Secure Attachments: Supporting syllabi, schedules, and circular documents up to 50MB per file.
  • Audit Trail Logging: Complete tracking of logins, notice publications, updates, and moderation actions.

Architecture & Stack

Backend

Java 17, Spring Boot 3, Spring Security, Hibernate ORM, MySQL, JWT (JJWT), Maven.

Frontend

React 18, React Router v6, Axios, Vanilla CSS Design System, Jest, React Testing Library.
